Overview

PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan) is a government scheme that promotes the use of solar energy in agriculture. It supports farmers and agricultural producers in installing solar pumps and solar power plants on their land, reducing dependence on grid electricity and diesel. The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Individual farmers, farmer groups, cooperatives, and panchayats can apply under different components
  • Must own agricultural land for installation of solar equipment
  • For Component A (solar power plants), the producer must have suitable land for the plant
  • For Component C (solar pumps), the farmer must be a valid agricultural consumer as per state norms

Benefits

  • Central Financial Assistance (CFA) as a percentage of the cost, with the balance covered by farmer contribution and bank loan (as per the component)
  • Reduced electricity and diesel costs for irrigation
  • Solar pumps help in areas with unreliable grid power
  • Additional income for farmers by selling surplus solar power to discoms (Component A)

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the state electricity distribution company (discom) or the designated implementing agency
  2. Select the scheme component suitable for your needs
  3. Submit the application with land documents and farmer details
  4. The agency verifies eligibility and processes the subsidy/loan

Required Documents

  • Land ownership documents
  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank account details
  • Farmer identity proof (kisan credit card, patta, etc.)

Important Links

Official details: mnre.gov.in (as per the official portal).

Overview

Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY) is a pension scheme for senior citizens aged 60 years and above. It provides a guaranteed return in the form of a monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly pension for a period of 10 years. The scheme is operated through Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) and offers an assured rate of return.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Indian resident aged 60 years and above at the time of enrolment
  • The policyholder can be the senior citizen or a family member on their behalf
  • Minimum purchase price of ₹1.5 lakh and maximum ₹15 lakh per senior citizen (as per the scheme norms)

Benefits

  • Guaranteed pension for 10 years, payable monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly
  • Assured rate of return as declared by the government for the scheme period
  • Option to choose the pension frequency
  • On death of the pensioner during the policy term, the purchase price is paid to the nominee
  • Loan facility available against the policy after completion of 3 policy years

How to Apply

  1. Visit any LIC branch or an authorised LIC agent
  2. Fill the PMVVY application form
  3. Submit the age proof and identity documents
  4. Pay the purchase price through cheque or online mode
  5. Receive the pension as per the chosen frequency

Required Documents

  • Age proof (birth certificate, passport, or similar)
  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank account details for pension credit
  • Nominee details

Important Links

Official details: licindia.in (as per the official portal).

meta_description: PMVVY offers a guaranteed 10-year pension with assured returns for senior citizens aged 60+. Check eligibility, benefits, and how to apply via LIC.

Overview

The Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) provides scholarships to the wards and dependents of deceased or disabled personnel of the armed forces, central and state police forces, and railway protection force. The scheme aims to support the education of children who have lost their earning parent in the line of duty. It is administered through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Wards and dependents of deceased/disabled personnel of armed forces, para-military forces, central and state police forces, and RPF
  • Applicant must have completed Class 12
  • Must be pursuing a professional or technical degree (as per scheme norms)
  • Family income limit as per the scheme guidelines

Benefits

  • Annual scholarship for professional/technical courses at graduation and post-graduation level
  • Amount paid per academic year as per the scheme norms (for eligible courses)
  • Renewable for the full course duration subject to academic performance

How to Apply

  1. Visit the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
  2. Register and complete the application with the PMSS scheme selection
  3. Upload the required documents including the parent's service certificate
  4. Submit the application and track its status on the portal

Required Documents

  • Service/disability certificate of the parent
  • Class 12 mark sheet
  • Bank account details
  • Aadhaar card

Important Links

Official portal: scholarships.gov.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: PM Scholarship Scheme: For Defence & Police Dependents
meta_description: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme supports education of wards of deceased/disabled defence and police personnel. Check eligibility and how to apply on NSP.

content:
Overview

National Scholarship Portal (NSP) is the government's single platform for all scholarships. It is a one-stop portal where students can apply for central, state, and departmental scholarships, track application status, and receive disbursements directly into their bank accounts. NSP eliminates duplication and brings transparency to the scholarship process.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Eligibility varies by scholarship scheme — check the specific scheme on the portal
  • Common requirements: Indian citizenship, Aadhaar, active bank account, and valid academic records
  • Some schemes have income and category (SC/ST/OBC/Minority) criteria

Benefits

  • Single registration for multiple central and state scholarships
  • Direct Benefit Transfer of scholarship amounts to bank accounts
  • Transparent application status tracking
  • Renewal facility for continuing students

How to Apply

  1. Register on scholarships.gov.in using your mobile number and email
  2. Complete the one-time registration with Aadhaar and bank details
  3. Select the applicable scholarship scheme
  4. Fill the application and upload documents
  5. Track the application status and institute verification on the portal

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank account details
  • Academic records / mark sheets
  • Category certificate (where applicable)
  • Income certificate (where required)

Important Links

Official portal: scholarships.gov.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: National Scholarship Portal: Apply for All Scholarships Online
meta_description: NSP is the single platform for central and state scholarships with direct benefit transfer. Learn how to register, apply, and track your scholarship.

Overview

PM SHRI Schools (Pradhan Mantri Schools for Rising India) is a centrally sponsored scheme to develop model schools that showcase the implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. The scheme aims to upgrade existing schools into PM SHRI schools with modern infrastructure, innovative teaching methods, and holistic development of students.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Existing government schools selected through a transparent competition-based process
  • Schools are selected by states/UTs and Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan / Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti
  • Students study in the selected PM SHRI schools as per the school's admission norms

Benefits

  • Modern classrooms, labs, and digital infrastructure
  • Implementation of NEP 2020 with experiential and skill-based learning
  • Focus on holistic development: academics, sports, arts, and life skills
  • Training for teachers and access to digital learning resources

How to Apply

  1. No direct student application — admission follows the regular process of the selected school
  2. Parents can apply for admission to a PM SHRI school as per the state's admission calendar
  3. For school selection, states submit proposals under the scheme guidelines

Required Documents

  • As per the school admission process (birth certificate, residence proof, Aadhaar, etc.)

Important Links

Official details: pmshrischools.education.gov.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: PM SHRI Schools: NEP 2020 Model Schools, Features
meta_description: PM SHRI Schools are model schools under NEP 2020 with modern infrastructure and holistic learning. Learn about features, selection, and admission.

Overview

Atal Tinkering Labs (ATL) is an initiative under the Atal Innovation Mission (AIM), NITI Aayog, to foster curiosity, creativity, and innovation among school students. ATLs are established in schools across India, providing students with access to modern tools and technologies like 3D printers, robotics kits, sensors, and microcontrollers to tinker and build innovative solutions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Schools (government and private) can apply to set up an Atal Tinkering Lab
  • Schools must have a minimum of 6th to 12th grade students
  • Selected schools receive a one-time grant for establishing the lab (as per AIM norms)

Benefits

  • Hands-on learning with modern tools: 3D printing, IoT, robotics, and coding kits
  • Encourages problem-solving and design thinking among students
  • Participation in national-level innovation challenges and ATL Marathon
  • Mentorship from industry experts and access to the AIM innovation ecosystem

How to Apply

  1. Schools apply through the Atal Innovation Mission portal during the application window
  2. Submit school details, infrastructure, and commitment to ATL guidelines
  3. Selected schools receive the grant and setup support
  4. Students participate through their school's ATL activities

Required Documents

  • School registration details
  • Infrastructure and faculty details
  • Commitment letter as per AIM guidelines

Important Links

Official details: aim.gov.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: Atal Tinkering Labs: Innovation Labs in Schools
meta_description: Atal Tinkering Labs bring robotics, 3D printing, and coding to school students. Learn how schools can apply and how students benefit from ATL.

Overview

National Digital Literacy Mission (NDLM), also known as the National Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (DISHA), was launched to make at least one person in every eligible household digitally literate. The mission provides basic digital literacy training covering the use of computers, the internet, digital payments, and e-governance services, with special focus on rural and underserved populations.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Indian citizens aged 14 to 60 years (as per the original scheme norms)
  • Preference to households without a digitally literate member
  • Priority for SC/ST, minorities, and economically weaker sections
  • Training is provided through registered training partners and Common Service Centres (CSCs)

Benefits

  • Free basic digital literacy training
  • Hands-on training on computers, mobile phones, and digital payment apps
  • Access to e-governance services and digital benefits
  • Certificate on successful completion of the training

How to Apply

  1. Contact your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or registered training partner
  2. Register for the digital literacy training program
  3. Complete the training sessions
  4. Appear for the assessment and receive the certificate

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Photograph
  • Proof of age (where required)

Important Links

Official details: csc.gov.in (as per the official portal).
meta_title: National Digital Literacy Mission: Free Digital Training
meta_description: NDLM/DISHA provides free basic digital literacy training for rural and underserved citizens. Learn about eligibility, training, and how to register.

Overview

The Mid Day Meal Scheme, now known as PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman), provides hot cooked meals to students in government and government-aided schools. The scheme aims to improve nutritional status, encourage school enrolment and attendance, and support children from economically weaker families. It is one of the largest school feeding programs in the world.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Students enrolled in government, government-aided, and local body schools
  • Coverage from primary to upper primary classes (as per the current norms, extended to other classes where applicable)
  • Also covers students in madrasas and other recognized educational institutions under the scheme

Benefits

  • Free hot cooked nutritious meals during school days
  • Improved nutrition and learning outcomes
  • Reduces the financial burden on families
  • Encourages school attendance, especially for girls

How to Apply

  1. No separate application is needed — the benefit is automatic for enrolled students
  2. Parents should ensure the child is enrolled in a school covered under the scheme
  3. For issues, contact the school headmaster or the block/state education office

Required Documents

  • School enrolment is sufficient; no separate documents required

Important Links

Official details: pmposhan.education.gov.in (as per the official portal).
